'''Tun-Badon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. He was a member of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group [[Rusher's Brigade]] and commanded the unit [[Serraknife Battalion]]. Rusher's Brigade fought for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] during the [[Battle of Gazzari]], and Tun-Badon and the rest of Serraknife Battalion were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the engagement.
